fact: On Wednesday 8 October 2025 the Fayoum health directorate's IT training centre closed a three-day course for 18 medical registration and statistics technicians from the governorate's health units and medical centres, given by the health ministry's officer for health-office mechanisation, with practical training in registering births and deaths and issuing certificates electronically within what the article calls the new mechanisation system.
title: ختام تدريب فنيي التسجيل الطبي والإحصاء على الميكنة بمركز تكنولوجيا المعلومات بالفيوم
